issues.detail: The Hebrew names 'יִשְׁוִי' (Ishvi) and 'מַלְכִּי־שׁוּעַ' (Malchi-shua) are personal names of Saul's sons, but the Chinese renders them as '以實衛人' and '米基書雅人', adding the suffix '人' (person/people), which changes the meaning from proper names to gentilic/ethnic designations. This is a mistranslation of the names.
